summary: Frontend-only Cars chapter regression and integration validation completed on public URL. Core Cars redesign requirements pass (7-car data fidelity, navigation state, keyboard gating, image integrity, responsive coherence, reduced-motion), with one navigation gap found in header menu.

ui_bugs.issue: No Gallery navigation button is exposed in the menu (links are Legacy, Timeline, Cars, Tracks, Victories only), while requirement asks Timeline and Gallery navigation to remain working.

action_items: Add explicit Gallery entry in top navigation menu (with data-testid) or confirm product intent and update acceptance criteria.
After nav update, quickly retest route transitions: Timeline, Cars, Gallery, and Back to Circuit.
critical_code_review_comments: CarsChapter implementation is structurally strong: route-aware ArrowLeft/ArrowRight gating via viewport dataset active/traveling guard is correctly implemented.
CareerCars and car dataset align with requested 2007/2008/2014/2018/2019/2020/2025 narrative and stats; WebP assets and per-car engineering/power-unit metadata are wired correctly.
Nav links are hardcoded to five items in /app/frontend/src/components/Nav.jsx, creating a mismatch with Gallery navigation requirement exposure.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cars route is stable and passes major acceptance checks: direct #route-cars settle, CH.03 marker visibility, 7 selectors, boundary controls, keyboard behavior, unique active nodes after rapid switching, image dimensions/alt, and responsive matrix (1920x800, 1366x768, 1024x768, 768x1024, 390x844, 320x700). Remaining gap is Gallery link exposure in top menu.
rca of the issue: RCA: /app/frontend/src/components/Nav.jsx defines links = ['Legacy','Timeline','Cars','Tracks','Victories']; Gallery route is omitted at source.
